purpose: non-canonical proposed character memory for multi-outfit kids-yoga animation
scope: Separate from CINE Slow English A2 / Bell & Leaf
source_status: Some images generated in conversation or Adobe, NOT downloaded into GitHub; no SHA256 and no final image approval. Text roster preserves owner design intent; existence of names does not imply original 33 independent face masters.

universal_rules.original_character_identity: Face shape, eyes, age-appropriate body proportions, signature hair, head ornaments, primary palette and personal symbol must be stable across angles/outfits/episodes
universal_rules.socks_requirements: Each character has unique comfortable fitted non-slip socks with themed print and clear silicone sole traction. No decorative loose attachments on soles or toes.
universal_rules.non_yoga_footwear: Sneakers permitted only off the mat in casual/street/sport introductions
universal_rules.production_quality: High fidelity polished CGI 3D, vivid modern kid-safe multi-style fashion, distinct facial identities, bright neutral D55 lighting, detailed hair/fabric, natural movement and anatomical QA
universal_rules.content_packaging: Designed for child audience; assess and apply platform child-directed labeling. Do not promise exemption from Made for Kids classification.
universal_rules.reference_priority: explicit user-approved single-character master > approved turnarounds > owner-selected lineup > provisional concept; text prompts never override approved identity
universal_rules.fail_closed: No approval, no matching uploaded reference or ambiguous identity => status PENDING, not LOCKED. No fake face lock or sock QC PASS.
universal_rules.model_sheet: One girl/boy per asset; full body front/3quarter/side/back, expressions, signature hair ornaments, all five distinct looks, closeup grip-sock top and sole, three safe yoga poses; yoga panels strictly sock-only.
universal_rules.merge_rule: Same face/hair identity = outfit variant; change of hair color or outfit alone does not create a new person. Similar faces but unverified names require human comparison; never merge automatically.
